changeSet.author: swiftcheck

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM parser WHERE dataset_name = 'lu_pep_europarl_former'

changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO parser ( list_provider_id, name, description, dataset_name, source_id, plugin_id, plugin_url, data_source_type, parser_kind, source_location, parameters, refresh_hours, retention_months, licence, attribution, enabled, created_at ) SELECT p.id, 'Anciens députés européens élus au Luxembourg', 'API open data du Parlement européen – anciens eurodéputés luxembourgeois (législatures précédentes)', 'lu_pep_europarl_former', NULL, 'lu-pep-europarl-former', 'D:/test parser 2/plugins/swiftcheck-aml-lu-pep-europarl-former-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar', 'HTTP_FILE', 'OPEN_DATA_FILE', 'https://data.europarl.europa.eu/api/v2/meps?country-of-representation=LU&parliamentary-term=9&limit=100&format=application/ld+json', '{"yearsAfterEnd": "5", "sourceUrl": "https://data.europarl.europa.eu/api/v2/meps?country-of-representation=LU&parliamentary-term=9&limit=100&format=application/ld+json"}', 24, 12, NULL, 'Parlement européen, data.europarl.europa.eu', TRUE, NOW() FROM list_provider p WHERE p.code = 'EU-PARL';
INSERT INTO parser_coverage (parser_id, function_id) SELECT p.id, f.id FROM parser p JOIN pep_category cat ON cat.code = 'LU-EU' JOIN pep_function f ON f.category_id = cat.id AND (f.label LIKE '%europarl%' OR f.label LIKE '%Parlement%' OR f.id = 16) WHERE p.dataset_name = 'lu_pep_europarl_former';
